scientific_integrity: The metric-dimension-three scalar was known previously; the claimed new fact is the full signed-star classification and five-component exchange geometry. Computational checks are corroboration of a separate finite combinatorial proof.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only minimum vertex-resolving sets of the twenty-vertex Desargues graph; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Five disconnected metric-basis exchange components of the Desargues graph
